name: Data Preview Kernel Plant
implementation_notes: Dual-mode component (list/detail driven by :id? route param), mirrors DataPreviewDepricarpingView.vue's watch()-driven mode switch exactly

Detail mode renders the Kernel Plant Detail grid read-only straight from stored columns (no recomputation, historical data), however many rows the record actually has (REVISED 2026-08-24: no longer always 24 -- this screen required NO functional code change for the entity-catalog v12 dynamic-add-row revision, since it already rendered `details.length` rows directly and already had an empty-state for zero rows) plus the same static 3-column Target Operasional reference table used by Form Kernel Plant (screen-044)
Checked By/Acknowledged By rendered read-only with no role restriction on viewing, consistent with Data Preview Threshing/Pressing/Depricarping and this screen's business spec

Playwright e2e spec (mobile/tests/e2e/data-preview-kernel-plant.spec.ts) REVISED 2026-08-24 alongside this fix to seed only 3 kernel_plant_detail rows (matching what a real saved record now typically looks like, mirroring data-preview-depricarping.spec.ts's already-revised seeding); the 'Back dari Mode Detail' assertion reverted from the exact-path regex workaround (added under the old fixed-24-row implementation, when this screen's own e2e run first surfaced the bare-glob-matching quirk) back to the plain '**/...' glob now that it mirrors data-preview-depricarping.spec.ts's own (working) assertion exactly -- kept for consistency across all 4 stations' sibling specs rather than carrying a station-specific workaround.

REVISI (tech-spec v3, kunci periode usecase-141 — sinkronisasi artefak, kode tidak diubah): mode detail memasang RecordVerificationActions (station-type='kernel-plant', local-table='kernel_plant_record') yang memanggil PATCH /api/records/kernel-plant/{server_id}/verification; backend RecordVerificationService::setVerification menerapkan peran + cakupan mill lalu assertPeriodOpenForWrite (EnforcesPeriodLock) atas `date` record sebelum menulis — periode stasiun tidak terbuka / tanggal di luar rentang → 422 PERIOD_CLOSED tanpa perubahan kolom; komponen menampilkan pesan server dan baris lokal tidak diperbarui (UPDATE lokal hanya setelah sukses); offline → pesan 'Butuh koneksi internet untuk verifikasi'. Tercakup oleh backend/tests/Feature/Api/RecordVerificationTest.php (blok 'kunci periode pada jalur verifikasi') dan backend/tests/Unit/Support/EnforcesPeriodLockTest.php; mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts mencakup galat offline tetapi belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus.

REVISI v4 (2026-10-03, sinkronisasi catatan uji — kode tidak diubah): celah 'recordVerification.spec.ts belum punya kasus PERIOD_CLOSED khusus' pada catatan REVISI kunci periode di atas kini TERTUTUP — mobile/tests/recordVerification.spec.ts menambah 'shows the period-lock (422 PERIOD_CLOSED) message verbatim as an error and leaves the local row untouched' untuk komponen bersama RecordVerificationActions yang dipasang di mode detail layar ini: pesan server 422 PERIOD_CLOSED ditampilkan apa adanya sebagai galat dan baris lokal tidak di-UPDATE. Uji hijau.

REVISI (2026-10-03, run penuh Playwright mobile 430 lulus / 0 gagal): mobile/tests/e2e/data-preview-kernel-plant.spec.ts 4/4 lulus — kini dijalankan ulang secara nyata (known_issue 'tidak dapat dijalankan ulang di sandbox' dihapus). Perbaikan spec (drift, bukan cacat aplikasi): cek negatif not.toHaveURL pada 'Back dari Mode Detail' kembali memakai RegExp — glob '**/…' polos (yang dipulihkan 2026-08-24, lihat catatan di atas) digabung ke baseURL sehingga tak pernah cocok.
